translations.literal: In Jin Emperor Yuandi's Yongchang year 1, Inspector Zu Yue, fleeing the Hu bandits, returned from Qiao to administer from Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: In Jin Yuandi's Yongchang 1, Inspector Zu Yue fled the Hu raiders, left Qiao, and moved his seat back to Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 壽春，淮南一都之會，地方千餘里，有陂田之饒，漢、魏以來揚州刺史所治，北拒淮水，《禹貢》云「淮海惟揚州」也。

translations.literal: Shouchun is the chief meeting-place of Huainan, over a thousand li in extent, rich in reservoir fields; since Han and Wei the seat of the Inspector of Yang Province, facing north to block the Huai River. The Yu Gong says, 「Between the Huai and the sea is only Yang Province.」
translations.idiomatic: Shouchun was Huainan's chief city, more than a thousand li across, rich in polder fields; since Han and Wei it had been the Yang inspector's seat, blocking the Huai to the north. The Yu Gong says, 「Between the Huai and the sea lies only Yang Province.」

sentences.zh: 咸和四年，祖約以城降胡，復以庾亮爲刺史，治蕪湖。

translations.literal: In Xianhe year 4, Zu Yue surrendered the city to the Hu, and Yu Liang was again made Inspector, with seat at Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianhe 4, Zu Yue surrendered the city to the Hu; Yu Liang was again made inspector, with his seat at Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 蕪湖，浦水南入，亦爲險奧。

translations.literal: Wuhu: the Pu River enters from the south—it too is a strategic chokepoint.
translations.idiomatic: Wuhu, where the Pu River enters from the south, was likewise a defensible narrows.

sentences.zh: 劉備謂孫權曰：「江東先有建業，次有蕪湖。

translations.literal: Liu Bei said to Sun Quan: 「East of the Jiang you first had Jianye, next Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bei told Sun Quan: 「East of the Yangtze you first had Jianye, then Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 」庾亮經略中原，以毛寶爲刺史，治邾城，爲胡所覆。

translations.literal: 」Yu Liang sought to recover the Central Plain and made Mao Bao Inspector, with seat at Zhucheng; it was overrun by the Hu.
translations.idiomatic: 」Yu Liang planned to recover the central plain, made Mao Bao inspector with his seat at Zhucheng, and the city was overrun by the Hu.

sentences.zh: 荊州刺史庾翼領州，在武昌。

translations.literal: Inspector of Jing Province Yu Yi held the province from Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yi of Jing Province held the province from Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 諸郡失土荒民數千無佃業，翼表移西陽、新蔡二郡荒民就陂田於尋陽。

translations.literal: Thousands of landless refugees from the various commanderies had no fields to work; Yi memorialized to move refugees from Xiyang and Xincai commanderies to reservoir lands at Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: Thousands of refugees from commanderies that had lost territory had no land to farm; Yi memorialized to settle refugees from Xiyang and Xincai on polder fields at Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 穆帝永和五年，胡偽揚州刺史王浹以壽春降，而刺史或治歷陽，進馬頭及譙，不復歸舊鎮也。

translations.literal: In Jin Emperor Mu's Yonghe year 5, Wang Yi, the Hu puppet Inspector of Yang, surrendered Shouchun; thereafter inspectors sometimes governed from Liyang, advancing to Matou and Qiao, and no longer returned to the old garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In Jin Emperor Mu's Yonghe 5, Wang Yi, the Later Zhao puppet inspector of Yang, surrendered Shouchun; afterward Yu inspectors sometimes sat at Liyang or advanced to Matou and Qiao, and no longer returned to the old seat.

sentences.zh: 哀帝隆和元年，袁真還壽春。

translations.literal: In Emperor Ai's Longhe year 1, Yuan Zhen returned to Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Ai's Longhe 1, Yuan Zhen returned to Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 真爲桓溫所滅，溫以子熙爲刺史，戍歷陽。

translations.literal: Zhen was destroyed by Huan Wen; Wen made his son Xi Inspector and garrisoned Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was destroyed by Huan Wen; Wen made his son Xi inspector and garrisoned Liyang.

sentences.zh: 孝武寧康元年，桓沖移姑熟，以邊寇未靜，分割譙、梁二郡見民，置之浣川，立爲南譙、梁郡。

translations.literal: In Emperor Xiaowu's Ningkang year 1, Huan Chong moved to Gushu; because border raiders were not yet quiet, he divided the resident population of Qiao and Liang commanderies, settled them on the Huanchuan, and established Southern Qiao and Liang commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Xiaowu's Ningkang 1, Huan Chong moved to Gushu; with border enemies still active, he split the registered households of Qiao and Liang commanderies, resettled them along the Huanchuan, and set up Southern Qiao and Liang commanderies.

translations.literal: In year 12, Huan Shiqian returned to Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Huan Shiqian returned to Liyang.

sentences.zh: 庾准爲刺史，表省諸權置，皆還如本。

translations.literal: Yu Zhun became Inspector and memorialized to abolish all provisional establishments, restoring everything to the original arrangement.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Zhun became inspector and memorialized to abolish every provisional district, restoring the former setup.

sentences.zh: 義熙二年，劉毅復鎮姑熟。

translations.literal: In Yixi year 2, Liu Yi again garrisoned Gushu.
translations.idiomatic: In Yixi 2, Liu Yi again garrisoned Gushu.

sentences.zh: 上表曰：「忝任此州，地不爲曠，西界荒餘，密邇寇虜，北垂蕭條，土氣彊獷，民不識義，唯戰是習。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial saying: 「I humbly hold this province; the land is no wilderness. The western border is ravaged remnant territory, close upon the enemy; the northern fringe is desolate. Local temperament is fierce and unruly; the people know no duty and are trained only for war.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial: 「I hold this province unworthily; the land is not empty. The west is wasted borderland hard against the enemy; the north is bleak. The local temper is fierce and wild—the people know no right conduct and are schooled only in fighting.

translations.literal: Fugitives run wild and gather by the day without plan.
translations.idiomatic: Deserters and outlaws meet daily without design.

sentences.zh: 比年以來，無月不戰，實非空乏所能獨撫。

translations.literal: In recent years there has been fighting every month; it is truly beyond what one man with empty coffers can pacify alone.
translations.idiomatic: Year on year there has been fighting every month; one empty-handed man truly cannot pacify it alone.

sentences.zh: 請輔國將軍張暢領淮南、安豐、梁國三郡。

translations.literal: I ask that Assists-the-State General Zhang Chang take charge of Huainan, Anfeng, and Liangguo—the three commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Assists-the-State General Zhang Chang oversee Huainan, Anfeng, and Liangguo commanderies.

translations.literal: 」At that time Yu Province's borders were so desolate that it came to this.
translations.idiomatic: 」At that time Yu Province's frontier was so wasted that it had come to this.

sentences.zh: 十二年，劉義慶鎮壽春，後常爲州治。

translations.literal: Pacify and receive the distant wilds; defend the border marches.
translations.idiomatic: He soothed the far borderlands and held the frontier.

translations.idiomatic: In Taishi 2 the seat was Liyang; in 3, Xuancheng; in 5 the province was abolished.

translations.literal: The Huai west fell to the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai west was lost to the northerners.

translations.literal: In year 7, the Huai east was again divided to establish Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 the Huai east was again split off to form Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 建元二年，太祖以西豫吏民寡刻，分置兩州，損費甚多，省南豫。

translations.literal: In Jianyuan year 2, because Western Yu's officials and people were few and exacting, and maintaining two provinces cost greatly, the High Ancestor abolished Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyuan 2 the High Ancestor abolished Southern Yu: Western Yu had too few officials and households to bear a second province, and the expense was heavy.

sentences.zh: 左僕射王儉啓：「愚意政以江西連接汝、潁，土曠民希，匈奴越逸，唯以壽春爲阻。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Wang Jian reported: 「My humble view is that policy should take the west of the river as connecting to Ru and Ying — the land vast, the people sparse; the northerners slip the border, and only Shouchun serves as a barrier.
translations.idiomatic: Left vice director Wang Jian reported: 「In my view the west-of-the-river lands tie to Ru and Ying — broad territory, thin population; raiders cross at will, and only Shouchun blocks them.

sentences.zh: 若使州任得才，虜動要有聲聞，豫設防禦，此則不俟南豫。

translations.literal: If the provincial post gets a capable man, when the barbarians stir there will necessarily be word of it; Yuzhou sets defenses in advance — then one need not depend on Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Give the province a capable inspector: when the enemy moves, word will come first; with Yuzhou already on guard, Southern Yu is unnecessary.

sentences.zh: 假令或慮一失，醜羯之來，聲不先聞，胡馬倏至，壽陽嬰城固守，不能斷其路，朝廷遣軍歷陽，己當不得先機。

translations.literal: If one should fear some single lapse — when the ugly Jie come, the report does not come first, Hu horses arrive in a flash, Shouchun holds the city firm and cannot cut their route, and the court sends troops to Liyang — one already cannot gain the initiative.
translations.idiomatic: If one fears a single failure — the Jie arrive before news, Hu horses are suddenly at the wall, Shouchun can only shut its gates and cannot sever their route, and court troops must come from Liyang — the initiative is already lost.

sentences.zh: 戎車初戒，每事草創，孰與方鎮常居，軍府素正。

translations.literal: When war-chariots are first alerted, every matter is improvised — how does that compare with a frontier garrison's constant residence and a military headquarters long established?
translations.idiomatic: At the first alarm everything is improvised — how can that match a permanent frontier garrison and a headquarters long in order?

translations.literal: Temporary assigned support — the benefit is truly slight.
translations.idiomatic: Ad hoc reinforcements yield very little.

translations.literal: In peace not forgetting danger — the good government of antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: In peace not forgetting danger — that is sound government of old.

sentences.zh: 所以江左屢分南豫，意亦可求。

translations.literal: Hence the Jiangzuo repeatedly divided Southern Yu — the intent may also be sought.
translations.idiomatic: That is why the Jiangzuo court has repeatedly split off Southern Yu — the reasoning is plain.

sentences.zh: 如聞西豫力役尚復粗可，今得南譙等郡，民戶益薄，於其實益，復何足云。

translations.idiomatic: In Yuanhui 2, Bozhao was made inspector; the provincial seat was first established, a gate was hewn through the mountain, and the Li and Liao were awed into submission.

translations.literal: The soil has miasma that kills people.
translations.idiomatic: The soil breeds miasma that kills.

sentences.zh: 漢世交州刺史每暑月輙避處高，今交土調和，越瘴獨甚。

translations.literal: In Han times Jiao inspectors every hot month would withdraw to high ground; now Jiao lands are mild, but Yue's miasma alone is severe.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jiao inspectors each summer withdrew to high ground; today Jiao is temperate, yet Yue's miasma alone remains deadly.

sentences.zh: 刺史常事戎馬，唯以貶伐爲務。

translations.literal: Inspectors are constantly occupied with military affairs; punitive campaigns alone are their business.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors live in the saddle; punitive campaigns are their sole concern.
